research_notes.text: Tadshe has Hiphil jussive 3fs morphology; the volitive Let the Earth sprout is not a narrative wayyiqtol.
Tadshe (sprout) and deshe (sprouts) have a visible related consonantal pattern; whether to show a linked root or wordplay requires scholarly root verification, not automatic homonym certification.
Oseh is a Qal participle of asah; OLT uses making, never shaping or the false simple-past made for this participle.
Lemino carries suffix 3ms, represented as to his kind, not a neuter its kind; bo 3ms is in him, with no separate numeric lexeme.
Vattotse is tagged Hiphil wayyiqtol 3fs. Earth is the feminine subject; she brought forth is proposed as simple past.
Vehayu is HC/Vqq3cp (conjunctive or sequential perfect), not HC/Vqw3ms; proposed and [they shall] be is contextual future/modal, not wayyiqtol.
Mo'adim may denote appointed times or seasons; the proposed appointed times does not claim a unique sense or a calendrical doctrine.
Leha'ir is Hiphil infinitive construct with lamed, to illuminate; it is not the separate asah/make lexeme.

verse_research.english_main_research_proposal: And God — He said: Let the Earth sprout sprouts, herb sowing seed, tree of fruit making fruit to his kind, whose seed [is] in him, upon the Earth; and so was.
And the Earth — she brought forth sprouts, herb sowing seed to his kind, and tree making fruit, whose seed [is] in him, to his kind; and God — He saw that — good.
And was evening, and was morning: day third.
And God — He said: Let lights be in the firmament of the Heavens, to separate between the day and between the night; and [they shall] be for signs, and for appointed times, and for days, and years.
And [they shall] be for lights in the firmament of the Heavens to illuminate upon the Earth; and so was.
